scope: Model and DOM emulation only. No rendered browser, screen reader, device, print or visual acceptance is asserted.

results.name: Two synthetic customers exist and only one is in context at a time
One organisation relates to several company-specific ERP accounts
One source account is returned with a similar name and no confirmed mapping
Every synthetic identity is a reserved SYN reference
Overview opens on the central question and names the relationship owner
Overview separates operator, property owner and bill payer
Every summary tile states the scope of what it counted
Each attention item names record, reason, owner, due meaning and next action
The workspace does not add a second application shell or navigation rail
The sales-order register lists only this customer’s mapped-account orders
Unresolved source records are separated, labelled and explicitly not counted
Order amounts are stated per currency and never consolidated
Outstanding supply is only computed where both measures are known
The order snapshot carries source, company, account and identity fields
Requested, confirmed and expected delivery are three distinct values
Ordered, allocated, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned and invoiced stay separate
The accepted quotation and its exact revision are retained on the order
A one-off line without a catalogue product is shown as a description
Partial fulfilment shows outstanding lines, a source hold and a missing expected date
A mapped difference from the accepted quotation is shown, not silently absorbed
Shipment and invoice references are shown per line
A failed observation retains last-good values and labels them stale
Unknown quantities on a stale order are rendered unknown rather than zero
Requesting a source refresh changes no record and says what happened
A cancelled order shows its cancellation and carries no invoice
A completed historical order retains its shipment and invoice references
An unmapped order states that it is attributed to nobody and counted nowhere
No ERP edit, release, cancellation, payment or fulfilment control exists
An accepted quotation with an unknown conversion is never presented as an order
Conversion and recovery link to ES-07 instead of being recreated here
Quotation states are distinguished as the source defines them
Alternative estimate options are marked mutually exclusive and never totalled
Successive revisions of one quotation are not counted as separate commitments
Opportunity forecast value is never added to orders, invoices or payments
A completed visit does not resolve the case or its remaining work
Symptom, suspected cause, verified finding and agreed resolution stay distinguishable
Report acknowledgement is bound to the exact issued revision
Billing state is stated separately from attendance
Customer warranty outcome and supplier recovery are separate facts
A new case with no work order shows its next action and date needed
No service level or priority threshold is invented
Technical completion, customer acceptance and commercial closeout are separate
A delivered and accepted project can still be commercially open
Variation values are not added to order or invoice measures
Equipment physical location and served growing areas stay distinct
The full hierarchy is linked rather than duplicated
Each asset appears once for its site
Finance visibility is withheld from the coordinator role without leaking a summary
Search cannot surface a restricted private communication
An operational-only role loses the commercial sections entirely
A permitted role sees account observations with their own source context
No account balance is derived from the rows that happened to arrive
Fixture F-01 keeps the original and the source remaining amount separate
Fixture F-02 unapplied cash is shown separately and nets nothing
A deposit held against an order does not make the order paid
A disputed invoice with no source remaining amount stays unknown
A different legal company and currency is never consolidated
Ageing bands, credit rules and undefined measures are not invented
A summary tile drills into the register behind it and offers a return
Return navigation restores the previous view and its filters
A site filter scopes orders to explicit site relationships only
An active filter is shown as a removable chip and can be cleared
Search runs within this customer’s records only
An empty result explains itself and offers a recovery control
An ERP company filter separates the two legal companies
Equipment context drills from an asset into its service history
Switching customer retains no record, filter, search or snapshot from the other
The second customer shows only its own records
Site options are scoped to the customer in context
The activity history retains source, author, date and exact document revision
Reading a timeline entry completes no underlying business action
Controlled documents are linked, not mastered again here
An internal note is saved, attributed and shown against its record
Saved notes survive a reload of the same browser storage
Malformed retained bytes are preserved and never silently overwritten
A refused storage write is reported truthfully as session-only
Note text is escaped rather than rendered as markup
R20 metadata, embedded fonts and every CSS token resolve
The file is self-contained: no external script, stylesheet or image request
Every element identity in the current document is unique
Tabs use roving tabindex and respond to arrow, Home and End keys
The content region is a labelled tab panel and dialogs are labelled
Desktop rows and phone cards represent the same matching records
The workspace states that it is synthetic and that MYOB remains the authority
A demonstration role switch is never described as real security
No page error was raised while running every interaction above
